editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a tiny metal box with eight strangers, and then you find out one of them is carrying a bomb that cannot be stopped. That is exactly the nightmare you get into here. The movie starts off slow, introducing you to a mixed bag of people, but the vibe changes fast once the panic sets in. You will feel the heat and the stress as these characters start to turn on each other. It is a wild ride where you see how quickly people can lose their cool when they think they are about to die.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is lying and who is actually in danger. The acting is solid, and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit far-fetched, the tension makes up for it. If you love movies that take place in one room and make you sweat, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the very end, the tension peaks as the group fights to survive. The big twist is that the whole situation was a setup. It turns out the bomb and the elevator trap were part of a sick social experiment to see how people behave under pressure. Most of the characters do not make it out alive, leaving you to realize that the real danger was not the bomb, but the other people in the room.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-tension survival stories and plot twists.
